## ⚠️ Correction to this card — the clobbering write is the **labeler's**, not the agent's

Filed by me 40 minutes ago on a near miss. A dev agent has since produced a **measured loss**,
and it inverts this card's diagnosis. Recording it here because the remedy list above is now
incomplete.

**PR #10698's label timeline, which I verified myself rather than taking from the report:**

| time | event | label | actor |
|---|---|---|---|
| 09:05:29Z | labeled | `skip-changeset` | `claude[bot]` |
| **09:05:30Z** | **unlabeled** | **`skip-changeset`** | **`github-actions[bot]`** |
| 09:05:30Z | labeled | `size/l` | `github-actions[bot]` |
| 09:06:03Z | labeled | `skip-changeset` | `claude[bot]` (re-applied) |

The agent did **everything this card asks for**: the additive `POST /issues/{n}/labels`, which
returned HTTP 200. **One second later the PR-size labeler's whole-set PUT erased it**, bundled
into the same write that added `size/l`.

So the danger I described — an agent forced into a read-modify-write by the permission
classifier — is real but is the *smaller* half. The larger half is that **a correct additive
write is not safe either**, because another actor is doing the whole-set write this repo forbids
its agents from doing. Only the agent's after-the-bots read-back caught it.

### What this does to the directions above

- **A** (allow the additive POST in the dev-agent permission set) is still right, and still
  necessary. It is **no longer sufficient**: A alone would have produced exactly this loss.
- **C** (refuse the whole-set write too) turns out to be aimed at the wrong actor. The write that
  needs refusing is `pr-automation.yml`'s.
- A fourth direction, which #10703 makes the concrete one: **make the size labeler additive**, so
  it stops erasing labels it did not add.

### On the audit

I checked every PR this seat opened tonight — #10661, #10662, #10665, #10668, #10670, #10674,
#10682, #10687, #10690, #10697, #10698. **#10698 is the only one carrying an `unlabeled` event,
and it was restored.** #10661 and #10697 correctly carry real changesets rather than the label
(`@objectstack/core` and `@objectstack/lint` both publish). So nothing was lost silently on this
board — but that is because the race needs the agent's POST to land inside a ~1 second window,
not because the write is safe.

Worth stating plainly: this card's own text says of #10682 *"No `unlabeled` event"*. That was
accurate for #10682 and is exactly the reading that made me call it a near miss. It was a near
miss **of a different mechanism than the one I named**.

⭐ Tracking detail from #10703 worth repeating: `pr-automation.yml`'s own header names this as the
open half of #5649 — **but #5649 and #5533 are both CLOSED**, so until now the only tracker was
prose inside a workflow comment.

**#10703 is the sharper card of the two.** Leaving this one open for the classifier half.
